it.title: Broodscale Bloodchief.
it.intro: Un mazzo da portare al Modern del mercoledì al Golden Store Talenti, a Roma. Ogni tappa del piano lascia una lista giocabile da 60 + 15, mentre continuo a giocare Standard Mono Green Landfall online su Endstep.
it.goal: Obiettivo: i 75 di Tetsubou, vincitore della MTGO Modern Challenge 32 del 25 ottobre 2026, con 2 Glaring Fleshraker fissi nel main.
it.prices: Scryfall EUR (derivato da Cardmarket), stampa più economica non foil e non digitale, letto il 26/10/2026. Esclusi spedizione, condizione e lingua; i prezzi cambiano, quindi i mesi successivi sono stime.
it.rules: Niente proxy: Forest e sostituti economici coprono gli slot mancanti. Il budget non speso passa al mese successivo, per acquistare anche le singole carte più care.
it.modification: Rispetto a Tetsubou: +2 Glaring Fleshraker, −1 Sire of Seven Deaths e −1 Dismember nel main; +1 Dismember e −1 Disruptor Flute in side. Restano 1 Sire, 1 Dismember in main e 2 in side. Con Broodscale + Blade, ogni Spawn di Fleshraker infligge 1 danno: la combo può chiudere subito.
it.status_note: Il mese indica la tappa del piano, non acquisti già eseguiti. Le liste sotto descrivono il mazzo dopo gli acquisti previsti per ciascun mese.
it.strength_note: Valutazione qualitativa del piano, non una percentuale di vittorie.
it.home_intro: Broodscale Bloodchief per il mercoledì al Golden Store Talenti. Un piano di acquisto con una lista giocabile a ogni tappa.
notes: Giocabile: la combo Basking Broodscale + Blade of the Bloodchief è completa e Glaring Fleshraker la fa vincere subito. Mana ancora grezzo (niente Labyrinth/Saga) e senza Kozilek's Command. Livello: lega di negozio budget.
Arrivano Kozilek's Command, Dismember e Thought-Knot Seer: interazione vera e più costanza. Side già sensato.
Primi 3 Ugin's Labyrinth: il piano ramp Eldrazi comincia a funzionare.
Labyrinth completi, primo Urza's Saga e Shifting Woodland.
Secondo Urza's Saga.
Terzo Urza's Saga: la Saga trova Blade e i pezzi da 1 mana con regolarità.
4 Urza's Saga e primo Emrakul.
Due Emrakul in più: il piano B grosso è quasi completo.
Main quasi definitiva: 4 Emrakul, 1 Sire e i 2 Glaring Fleshraker fissi. Prima Trinisphere in side. Mancano solo le terre di lusso.
Side completo con 3 Trinisphere.
Primo Boseiju.
Secondo Boseiju.
Lista completa: i 75 di Tetsubou con la modifica di Giacomo (2 Glaring Fleshraker fissi al posto di 1 Sire of Seven Deaths e 1 Dismember spostato in side; −1 Disruptor Flute in side).

en.title: Broodscale Bloodchief.
en.intro: A deck for Wednesday Modern at Golden Store Talenti in Rome. Every stage of the plan leaves a playable 60 + 15 list, while I keep playing Standard Mono Green Landfall online on Endstep.
en.goal: Goal: Tetsubou’s 75 from the October 25, 2026 MTGO Modern Challenge 32 win, keeping 2 Glaring Fleshraker in the final main deck.
en.prices: Scryfall EUR (derived from Cardmarket), cheapest nonfoil, non-digital printing, fetched October 26, 2026. Shipping, condition and language are excluded; prices change, so later months are estimates.
en.rules: No proxies: Forest and inexpensive substitutes cover the missing slots. Unspent budget carries into the next month to fund the more expensive individual cards.
en.modification: Compared with Tetsubou: +2 Glaring Fleshraker, −1 Sire of Seven Deaths and −1 Dismember in the main; +1 Dismember and −1 Disruptor Flute in the sideboard. This leaves 1 Sire, 1 main-deck Dismember and 2 in the sideboard. With Broodscale + Blade, each Spawn triggers Fleshraker for 1 damage: the combo can win immediately.
en.status_note: The month marks the stage of the plan, not completed purchases. The lists below show the deck after the planned purchases for each month.
en.strength_note: A qualitative assessment from the plan, not a win rate.
en.home_intro: Broodscale Bloodchief for Wednesdays at Golden Store Talenti. A purchase plan with a playable list at every stage.
notes: Playable: Basking Broodscale + Blade of the Bloodchief is a complete combo and Glaring Fleshraker makes it win immediately. The mana is still rough (no Labyrinth/Saga), with no Kozilek’s Command. Level: budget store league.
Kozilek’s Command, Dismember and Thought-Knot Seer arrive: real interaction and more consistency. The sideboard already has a solid base.
The first 3 Ugin’s Labyrinth: the Eldrazi ramp plan starts working.
The full set of Labyrinth, the first Urza’s Saga and Shifting Woodland.
The second Urza’s Saga.
The third Urza’s Saga: Saga finds Blade and the one-mana pieces more reliably.
4 Urza’s Saga and the first Emrakul.
Two more Emrakul: the big backup plan is nearly complete.
The main is almost final: 4 Emrakul, 1 Sire and the 2 permanent Glaring Fleshraker. First Trinisphere in the sideboard. Only the premium lands remain.
The sideboard is complete with 3 Trinisphere.
First Boseiju.
Second Boseiju.
Complete list: Tetsubou’s 75 with Giacomo’s modification (2 permanent Glaring Fleshraker replacing 1 Sire of Seven Deaths and 1 Dismember moved to the sideboard; −1 Disruptor Flute in the sideboard).
